t: This is the Memorial to Prisoners of War and Victims of Concentration Camps, in Dollis Hill. It was made by Fred Kormis, a German-born sculptor who settled in Britain. Kormis was best known for his bronze portrait medallions. He showed 41 pieces at the Royal Academy, with subjects including Edward VIII, Winston Churchill and Charlie Chaplin. Examples of his medallions are in the National Portrait Gallery, the British Museum and the Royal Collection.
